calls.reason: No independent source reports the $8.84bn pre-allocation 2024 net loss; follow-on coverage gives only operating and attributable losses, and arithmetic from Zitron's own figures is not verification.

The FT says it independently verified the audited documents and reports about $13bn revenue, $34bn spending and a roughly $39bn attributable loss; Quartz repeats the $20.92bn operating loss. No counterevidence.
Only reports repeating the leak (Ars Technica, TechTimes) carry the $10.59bn Microsoft R&D figure; the FT's verification doesn't cover it, and payment versus expense is unresolved.
Only Quartz repeats the balance-sheet description, from the same leaked documents; the FT doesn't confirm it and the actual balance sheet wasn't located.
The FT independently confirms attributable net loss rose nearly eightfold, from $5bn to about $39bn. Much of it was a one-off noncash charge, but operating loss also grew from $8.78bn to $20.92bn.
